caption: The drawing depicts a single vase, rendered in pencil on a plain, light-colored, possibly beige background. The vase has a narrow neck that flares outward at both the top and bottom, creating an hourglass shape. At the top section of the vase, there is a decorative motif featuring a cluster of grapes with leaves and vines wrapping around the neck. In the lower section, a similar design of leaves and berries or small fruits decorates the surface. The central portion of the vase contains a large, vertically oriented oval medallion or inset, outlined with a dotted border, which is left plain in the middle. The shading on the vase suggests a smooth, reflective surface. The artist’s signature, “Henry Meyers,” appears in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Lamp
